issues.on_page: Budget and Actual - All Funds: State 62,577 (excludes it); Local 463,702 (= 9,630 + 688 + 317,173 + 4,067 + 132,144)
issues.issue: The report's budget schedule puts the 132,144 'Restricted for streets' grant under Local revenue, not State or Federal, so 'other state aid' doesn't fit. A Local grant would be county/other local governments, or donations/contributions if private. The same question applies to receipts[2].category (intergovernmental/state aid).

issues.on_page: Total Governmental Funds: Operating transfers in (out) 12,334
issues.issue: Transfers are taken gross from the General and Street columns, while the Total column prints one net figure, 12,334. The arithmetic and roll-forward are correct, but this differs from the Total-column convention (Sutton records the net figure).
